About me

Hi, I’m Julien.

I’m an independent developer and technical writer interested in systems programming, Linux, software architecture, data processing, performance, and the machinery hidden underneath everyday tools.

A lot of what I write starts with a simple question:

“How does this actually work?”

This blog is an archive of my knowledge for my future self.

AI Note

I use generative AI to help me correct spelling mistakes (I’m French) and as a tutor to assist me with certain parts of the documentation process, such as finding links or historical information for the articles.

An article always originates from my own experiments, and I write all the explanations myself because it helps me better understand the topics. As written above, “This blog is an archive of my knowledge for my future self.”

I also use generative AI to generate the thumbnails for each article. (I also used it to generate my blog mascot you see above.)
